objective: Harden the Node Operator and GitOps CI/CD boundaries, execute a disposable private DAST run, and leave independently verifiable evidence before resuming validator UC-1 through UC-5 validation.
scope: GitHub workflow, repository-rule, and environment protections
GitOps private-CD and private-DAST execution boundaries
non-secret CI/CD evidence and contract tests
read-only validator readiness and activity evidence
out_of_scope: reading, creating, or exporting Vault tokens, recovery keys, or validator keystores
persistent external DAST targets or public EKS access

authorizations.pull_requests_and_merges: user authorized by the active goal
authorizations.GitHub_repository_and_environment_harden: user authorized by the active goal
authorizations.AWS_changes: only least-privilege, task-scoped resources; inspect before apply

success_criteria: No temporary EKS bootstrap administrator access remains
GitOps repository has protected main-branch controls and security features enabled
GitOps CD verifies the pinned chart deployment and runs a disposable, private, digest-pinned passive DAST job without raw-report disclosure
Every changed workflow is syntactically and supply-chain validated
UC evidence distinguishes observed validator facts from unperformed secret-dependent actions
escalation_trigger: Any operation needing a Vault/recovery/keystore value, a non-scoped IAM permission, or a destructive production action stops for explicit user direction.
